lessons.title: Monday Morning Small Talk
lessons.description: You run into a teammate by the coffee machine. Keep the small talk going and ease into the week.

learningObjectives.description: Say one thing about your weekend
Ask the other person a follow-up question

targetPhrases.usage: A standard Monday opener with coworkers you know.
Use this when you didn't do anything special.
targetPhrases.example: It was pretty quiet, actually — I just caught up on sleep.

targetPhrases.usage: A quick way to hand the question back to the other person.
targetPhrases.example: I mostly relaxed. How about you?

opening.text: Morning! Long weekend for you? How was it?

lessons.title: Monday Morning Project Update
lessons.description: Give your PM a quick, natural update on where the feature stands before the weekly sync.

learningObjectives.description: Explain a current blocker or dependency

targetPhrases.usage: Use this when something is nearly finished.
targetPhrases.example: The API work is basically there — I'm almost done with it.

targetPhrases.phrase: I'm still waiting for the latest UX feedback.
targetPhrases.meaning: 我還在等最新的 UX feedback。
targetPhrases.usage: Use this when another person or team is blocking progress.
targetPhrases.example: The layout is ready, but I'm still waiting for the latest UX feedback.

targetPhrases.phrase: I should have it done by Friday.
targetPhrases.meaning: 我應該可以在週五前完成。
targetPhrases.usage: A natural way to give a soft deadline / ETA.
targetPhrases.example: If nothing else comes up, I should have it done by Friday.

lessons.title: Explain a Blocker
lessons.description: A teammate asks why the deploy is stuck. Explain the blocker clearly and say what you need to move forward.

learningObjectives.description: State clearly what is blocking you
Explain the impact of the blocker
Ask for a specific next step or help

targetPhrases.phrase: I'm blocked on the staging database.
targetPhrases.meaning: 我卡在 staging 資料庫上。
targetPhrases.usage: "blocked on X" names the exact thing stopping you.
targetPhrases.example: I'm blocked on the staging database — migrations won't run.

targetPhrases.phrase: I can't move forward until it's fixed.
targetPhrases.meaning: 在修好之前我沒辦法繼續。
targetPhrases.usage: Explains the impact without sounding dramatic.
targetPhrases.example: The tests all depend on it, so I can't move forward until it's fixed.

targetPhrases.phrase: Could you help me get access, or point me to the right person?
targetPhrases.meaning: 你可以幫我拿到權限，或告訴我該找誰嗎？
targetPhrases.usage: Asks for a concrete next step instead of just complaining.
targetPhrases.example: Could you help me get access, or point me to the right person?

opening.text: Hey, I saw the deploy is still red. What's going on with it?
